info.title: Hawkin Force Platform API
info.description:
## Overview
This API provides programmatic access to your Hawkin force platform data.

**Designed for server-to-server use.** Not intended for direct client-app access.

**Rate limiting:** As your database grows, use `from`/`to` or `syncFrom`/`syncTo` parameters to limit response size. Responses exceeding the memory limit will fail.

### Recommended Sync Strategy
- **Incremental (ongoing):** Scheduled job using `syncFrom`/`syncTo` every 5 minutes
- **Historical bulk export:** Use `from`/`to` per month in parallel or sequential requests

### Team-Scoped Tokens
A Refresh Token may be **scoped to specific teams**. When it is, the Access Token it produces restricts **every read** to those teams:
- List endpoints (tests, athletes, teams, groups) return only in-scope records.
- Requesting a specific out-of-scope resource returns an **empty result with HTTP 200** — an empty object (`{}`) for single-resource endpoints such as `/forcetime/{test_id}` and `/cop/{test_id}`, or an empty `data` array for list endpoints. It does **not** return `404`.

Design your integration to treat an empty 200 response as "no access / no data" rather than an error.

### What's New in 1.15
- **New endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/cop/{test_id}` — center-of-pressure time series for Free Run tests.
- **Force-Time data** now documents shear forces (`XLeftForce(N)` … `YRightForce(N)`), moments (`XLeftMoments` … `YRightMoments`), and `eid`. `rsi` is an array of numbers, `timestamp` is an integer (Unix seconds), and `testType` is the full test-type object.
- **Tests:** non-calculable metric values are `null` (not `"N/A"`); each test includes an `active` boolean by default.
- **Metrics:** the per-test-type field is `testTypeName`.
- **Test Types:** response is a bare JSON array.
- **Teams / Groups / Tags:** responses include a `count` field; `teamId` query param documented on Athletes, Teams, and Groups.
- Documented **team-scoped token** behavior (see above).

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Obtain access tokens using your refresh token. A refresh token may be scoped to specific teams, in which case the resulting access token restricts all reads to those teams (out-of-scope requests return empty results with HTTP 200).

tags.name: Tests
tags.description: Retrieve test results and force-time data

tags.name: Organization
tags.description: Teams, groups, tags, test types, and metrics

BearerAuth.description: Enter your Refresh Token (from Settings → Integrations in the Hawkin dashboard). It will be exchanged for a short-lived Access Token automatically.

access_token.description: JWT access token to use in subsequent API requests

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp when the token expires

segment.description: Test type and trial number within session

eid.description: Equipment ID of the hardware that produced the test. Only present when the request was made with includeEid=true.

active.description: Whether the test is active (not archived). Included by default because the public endpoint uses includeInactive=true; set includeInactive=false to return only active tests.

additionalProperties.description: Metric values keyed by metric name (e.g. 'Jump Height(m)'). Non-calculable metrics are returned as null (the public endpoint uses useNulls=true), not the string 'N/A'.

lastTestTime.description: Unix timestamp of the most recent test

lastSyncTime.description: Unix timestamp to use as syncFrom in your next request

hasMore.description: True if more pages exist. Only present when paginate=true.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for next page. Null on last page. Only present when paginate=true.

image.description: URL to the athlete's photo. Three-state: omitted when never set, null when explicitly cleared, string when set.

position.description: Free-text playing position (e.g. "Forward"). Omitted when blank.

dob.description: Date of birth as ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when blank.

sport.description: Free-text sport name (e.g. "Basketball"). Omitted when blank.

height.description: Athlete height in centimeters. Guaranteed numeric and in-range when present. Omitted entirely when no valid height is on file.

lastTestedOn.description: Unix epoch seconds of the athlete's most recent test session. Omitted when the athlete has no tests on file.

external.description: Custom external properties as key-value pairs
Custom properties. Note: custom properties NOT present in the request will be REMOVED.

eid.description: Equipment ID of the hardware that produced the test. Null when unavailable.

XLeftForce(N).description: Medio-lateral (X-axis) shear force under the left platform.

XRightForce(N).description: Medio-lateral (X-axis) shear force under the right platform.

YLeftForce(N).description: Anterior-posterior (Y-axis) shear force under the left platform.

YRightForce(N).description: Anterior-posterior (Y-axis) shear force under the right platform.

XLeftMoments.description: Moment about the X-axis under the left platform.

XRightMoments.description: Moment about the X-axis under the right platform.

YLeftMoments.description: Moment about the Y-axis under the left platform.

YRightMoments.description: Moment about the Y-axis under the right platform.

rsi.description: Reactive Strength Index values (one per contact/flight cycle).

COPData.description: Center-of-pressure time series for a Free Run test. `Time(s)` is derived from the platform sampling rate (hertz). copX/copY are the combined center of pressure; leftCop*/rightCop* are per-platform.

eid.description: Equipment ID of the hardware that produced the test. Null when unavailable.

Time(s).description: Sample timestamps in seconds, derived from the sampling rate (hertz).

testTypeName.description: Human-readable name of the test type (e.g. 'Countermovement Jump').

get.description:
Exchange your Refresh Token for a short-lived Access Token (1 hour). Generate your Refresh Token in the Hawkin dashboard under **Settings → Integrations**. Only the organization administrator account can generate API tokens.

**Note:** After you authenticate using the Authorize button above, executing this endpoint will use your cached refresh token to demonstrate the exchange.

401.description: Refresh Token is invalid or expired

get.description:
Retrieve test results for your organization. Returns all tests unless filtered. **Important:** For large databases, always use time-range parameters to avoid memory limit failures.

**Note:** Available metrics can change at any time. Some tests may be missing metrics if they cannot be calculated.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Unix timestamp — return tests from this time onward. Best for bulk historical exports.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Unix timestamp — return tests up to this time. Best for bulk historical exports.

parameters.name: syncFrom
parameters.description: Unix timestamp — return tests **modified or created** since this time. Includes updates. Best for incremental sync. Cannot be used to fetch entire database.

parameters.name: syncTo
parameters.description: Unix timestamp — upper bound for syncFrom queries. Store the returned `lastSyncTime` value and pass as `syncFrom` in your next request.

parameters.name: athleteId
parameters.description: Filter by a specific athlete ID. Can only be used with `from`/`to` parameters.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more team IDs (comma-separated, max 10). Can only be used with `from`/`to` parameters.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: Filter by one or more group IDs (comma-separated, max 10). Can only be used with `from`/`to` parameters.

parameters.name: testTypeId
parameters.description: Filter by a specific test type ID. Can only be used with `from`/`to` parameters.

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: Default true. Set to false to return only active tests.

parameters.name: includeEid
parameters.description: Default false. Set to true to include the hardware `eid` (equipment ID) on each returned test record.

parameters.name: paginate
parameters.description: Set to true to enable paginated responses (1,000 tests per page).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Firestore document ID from previous response's nextCursor. Omit on first request.

200.description: Array of test results matching the query

get.description: Retrieve the raw force-time series data for a specific test. Returns time-series arrays for left force, right force, combined force, velocity, displacement, and power sampled at 1ms intervals.

parameters.name: test_id
parameters.description: The test ID to retrieve force-time data for

200.description: Force-time data for the requested test

get.description:
Retrieve the center-of-pressure (COP) time series for a **Free Run** test. Returns `Time(s)` (derived from the platform sampling rate in hertz) alongside combined and per-platform COP coordinates.

**Free Run tests only.** This endpoint returns COP data exclusively for Free Run tests.

**Team-scoped tokens:** if the access token is scoped to teams that do not include this test, the endpoint returns an empty object (`{}`) with HTTP 200 rather than a 404.

parameters.name: test_id
parameters.description: The Free Run test ID to retrieve COP data for

200.description: COP data for the requested Free Run test. A team-scoped token without access to the test receives an empty object ({}) with status 200.

404.description: Returned when the test does not exist, is not a Free Run test, or has no COP data.

get.description:
Retrieve all test types available in the Hawkin system (e.g. Countermovement Jump, Squat Jump, Drop Jump).

**Note:** Unlike the other list endpoints, this endpoint returns a **bare JSON array** (`[{ id, name }, ...]`), not an object wrapped in `data`.
Retrieve all metrics available for each test type, including ID, label, units, and description. Useful for building metric lookup tables.

200.description: Array of test types with their associated metrics

get.description: Retrieve all athletes in your organization. Returns only active athletes by default; set includeInactive=true to also include archived records.

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: Default false. Set to true to also include athletes whose `active` field is false.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict results to one or more teams (comma-separated team IDs). With a team-scoped token, results are already limited to the token's teams.

post.description: Create a single new athlete record.
Bulk create up to **500 athletes** in a single request. Returns details of successfully created athletes and any failures.

200.description: Bulk creation result with successes and failures

put.description:
Bulk update up to **500 athletes** in a single request.

**Note:** Optional fields not included in the request will be left unchanged. However, when updating `external` properties, any custom properties **not present in the request will be removed**.

200.description: Bulk update result with successes and failures

put.description:
Update a single athlete by ID.

**Note:** Optional fields not included will be left unchanged. However, when updating `external` properties, custom properties **not present in the request will be removed**.

get.description: Retrieve all teams in your organization with their IDs and names.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict results to one or more teams (comma-separated team IDs). With a team-scoped token, results are already limited to the token's teams.

get.description: Retrieve all groups in your organization with their IDs and names.

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Optional. Restrict results to one or more teams (comma-separated team IDs). With a team-scoped token, results are already limited to the token's teams.

get.description: Retrieve all tags in your organization. Tags are used to sub-classify tests within a test type (e.g. 'Arm Swing', 'Right Single Leg').
